title: Rex and the Truck That Took the Long Way
synopsis: Dan delivers hen feed to Green Gate Farm by the long vehicle road while Rex and friends walk over Little Bridge. Jack notices the routes are different and Gus suggests a public picture map.
continuity_state: Before: Season Ten ended in late spring with Green Gate Farm's existing side wagon-door shelter repaired and its green wheelbarrow returned; Dan and his blue delivery truck still serve the farm by the long road. After: Dan has delivered a routine hen-feed order by the long vehicle road while the friends walk to the farm via Pine Park and Little Bridge. Jack sketches the two distinct routes with paw/wheel marks. Gus proposes a neighborhood picture map at the park gate; nothing is built yet.
